observation: GraphPanel.jsx caps type previews at 48px and spacing previews at 96px (lines 47 and 57); these are view-specific bounds with no graph-owned tokens.

Workspace.jsx fixes the dependency graph at a minimum of 112px, uses 52px rows plus 20px padding, and truncates graph labels after 14 characters (lines 105 and 107). The view graph records route identity, not these dimensions.

styles/graph.css fixes stats text at 24px, swatch height at 36px, diagnostics max-height at 180px, and export textarea min-height at 140px (lines 14, 62, 83, and 93). The panel design graph has no field for these values.
The panel-workbench token graph owns palette colors and a shared 24px gutter, but no general per-view responsive or layout dimensions.

Observed per-file distinct fixed dimensions: base.css 17; chat.css 9 including 340px breakpoint; components.css 25 including 380px and 760px breakpoints; graph.css 16; import.css 15 including 440px preview height; review.css 5; workspace.css 32 including 320px, 380px, and 420px breakpoints.
Fixed palette colors resolve to graph tokens, and relay.css has no fixed dimension literals. Those checks do not assign field ownership to the listed per-view dimensions.
